controls.name: known-loss-latched-after-poll

controls.assertion_message: oracle known loss closes real admission before actual poll

controls.name: returned-hold-latch-omitted
controls.new: // Negative control: leave closure until scope exit.
controls.assertion_message: oracle retained poll error closes real port without stopping child

controls.name: blocking-stop-substitutes-for-atomic-latch
